column1: The identity test: day-ahead power vs the marginal cost of gas-fired generation
Real 2025 USD/MWh unless stated (annual-average market FX, Fed H.10; deflated with US CPI-U). Excludes VAT.

Real 2025 USD/MWh, converted at annual-average market FX and deflated with US CPI-U. SRMC = (hub gas, HHV + carbon × 0.183 tCO2/MWhth) ÷ efficiency; corridor 46–55%, line 50%. Annual averages, not hourly dispatch. Sources. Gas: Ofgem (2014–16), ONS SAP (2018–25), BNetzA (THE), European Commission and ACER (TTF); UK 2010–13, 2017 and TTF 2010–20 from the EI Statistical Review. Carbon: EUA/UKA auctions plus £18 Carbon Price Support, checked against ICAP. Emission factor: DESNZ 2025.
